Please note: to ensure that candidates select the most relevant jobs for their skills, we have set up limits to the number of times candidates can apply.

The following limits apply to all roles at Sardine:

  • Candidates may not apply more than 3 times in any 60 day span for any job.

  • Candidates may not re-apply to the same role within 90 days.
